co2.summary: CO₂ growth reaches 2 ppm a year as El Niño weakens carbon sinks
co2.state: Mauna Loa recorded 427.2 ppm in the week of 25 Oct, 2.00 ppm higher than a year earlier, reaching the 2 ppm/yr Watch line from 1.59 ppm the previous week. Strong El Niño years usually speed up CO₂ growth as land carbon sinks weaken.
co2.for_you: Faster CO₂ growth means more warming locked in. There is no immediate personal risk; this is a long-run indicator.

sources.title: NOAA GML — Trends in atmospheric CO₂ (Mauna Loa)

enso.summary: Strong El Niño: ONI +2.2, a 'super' event
enso.state: NOAA's Oceanic Niño Index for July–September was +2.16°C, well above the +1.5°C threshold for a strong event; the event reached 'super' status in September (Al Jazeera, 15 Sep). Strong El Niños typically peak in northern winter. No new ONI value as of 1 Nov.
enso.for_you: Expect disrupted weather worldwide: drought in Australia, southern Africa and Indonesia, and floods in parts of South America and East Africa.

sources.title: NOAA CPC — Oceanic Niño Index
Al Jazeera — El Niño reaches super status

coral-bleaching.summary: Fourth global bleaching event ended in June; El Niño threatens a fifth
coral-bleaching.state: NOAA confirmed in June 2026 that the fourth global coral bleaching event had ended. Reef agencies in the Seychelles and Caribbean have warned that the strong El Niño could trigger new bleaching as Southern Hemisphere waters warm; no new regional mass bleaching was confirmed as of 1 Nov.
coral-bleaching.for_you: Reef-dependent fisheries and tourism face renewed risk over the coming southern summer.

sources.title: GCRMN — Fourth global bleaching event ended
Nature Seychelles — What a strong El Niño warning means for coral reefs

who-emergencies.summary: One WHO global emergency in force: Ebola in Central Africa
who-emergencies.state: WHO's Bundibugyo Ebola emergency of international concern (PHEIC), declared in May, remains in force; WHO's 23 Oct update said its risk assessment is being revised. No new PHEIC had been declared in the 30 days to 2 Nov.
who-emergencies.for_you: Follow NHS and UKHSA advice; travellers to affected areas should check FCDO and NaTHNaC guidance.

sources.title: WHO — Disease Outbreak News: Ebola (Bundibugyo), DR Congo, Kenya and Nigeria
ECDC — Ebola disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, update 28 Oct

ebola.summary: Ebola tops 10,000 cases in DR Congo with imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria
ebola.state: ECDC's 28 Oct update counted 10,141 confirmed cases and 4,928 deaths in DR Congo to 27 Oct, with 81 new cases since its previous update, and says the outbreak is likely larger than reported. Kenya has nine cases and two deaths, and Nigeria confirmed an imported case on 20 Oct. ECDC rates the risk to the general EU population as very low.
ebola.for_you: Risk in the UK is very low. Travellers to affected areas should follow FCDO, NaTHNaC and UKHSA guidance.

sources.title: ECDC — Ebola disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, update 28 Oct
WHO — Disease Outbreak News: Ebola (Bundibugyo), DR Congo, Kenya and Nigeria
UN News — WHO supports Nigeria after first Ebola case confirmed

ebola.rubric_hit: Spread to a new country within 30 days (Nigeria, 20 Oct) = Alert

h5n1.summary: Sporadic H5N1 human cases from animals; no human-to-human spread
h5n1.state: Washington State reported a human H5N1 case on 15 Oct in a person exposed to infected dairy cattle; the state found no human-to-human transmission. No new human cluster had been reported as of 2 Nov.
h5n1.for_you: Risk to the public is low. Avoid contact with sick or dead birds and report them to Defra.

sources.title: Washington State DOH — Health alert: human avian influenza case

mpox.summary: Clade I mpox now spreading locally in the US
mpox.state: Clark County, Nevada reported its first clade I mpox case with no travel link (20 Oct), and Stanislaus County, California has confirmed two clade I cases, signs of local transmission of the more severe strain outside Africa. No new US clusters were reported as of 1 Nov.
mpox.for_you: Risk to the general public is low. Vaccination is available for those at higher risk via sexual health services.

sources.title: KOLO — First clade I mpox case reported in Clark County resident
Medscape — Mpox clade I shows domestic side

mpox.value: Clade I local spread in US

measles.summary: US measles cases at 4,852 in 2026, the most since elimination
measles.state: The CDC reported 4,852 confirmed US measles cases as of 29 Oct, more than double 2025's total, with three deaths. Analysts say the US is highly likely to lose its measles elimination status this autumn (CIDRAP).
measles.for_you: Check that you and your children are up to date with MMR vaccination, especially before travel.

sources.title: Contagion Live — Measles update, 30 Oct
CIDRAP — US highly likely to lose measles elimination status

cholera-dengue.summary: Cholera spikes in DR Congo; record dengue in Florida and Bangladesh
cholera-dengue.state: UN agencies report cholera cases spiking in DR Congo alongside the Ebola response (October), and the Central African Republic has declared a cholera outbreak. Florida's dengue outbreak is the largest in a US state in decades, and Bangladesh's dengue death toll is still rising. No WHO grade 3 declaration as of 1 Nov.
cholera-dengue.for_you: Use mosquito protection when travelling to dengue-affected regions; check TravelHealthPro before travel.

sources.title: UN News — Cholera spikes in DR Congo
Medical Xpress — Florida dengue outbreak largest in a state
EMPHNET — Central African Republic declares cholera outbreak

cholera-dengue.value: Cholera in DRC; record dengue seasons

novel-outbreaks.summary: No unexplained disease clusters under international investigation
novel-outbreaks.state: WHO reported in October a single death from pneumonia of undetermined cause in Irkutsk, Russia; plague was ruled out and contacts stayed well. No unexplained clusters were under international investigation as of 2 Nov.
novel-outbreaks.for_you: No action needed beyond routine health advice.

sources.title: WHO — Disease Outbreak News: Pneumonia of undetermined etiology, Russia

cyber.summary: Record $6.3bn Binance theft blamed on North Korea; Russian alert app hacked on 2 Nov
cyber.state: The FBI said on 1 Nov that North Korea stole about $6.3bn from Binance in late October, the largest crypto theft on record. Russia's emergencies ministry said its public alert app was hit overnight into 2 Nov and used to send false messages. Belgium took its tax portal offline after an attack on 28 Oct. No national-scale outage of power or health systems was reported as of 2 Nov.
cyber.for_you: Be alert to phishing linked to data-breach news; NCSC guidance covers how to protect accounts.

sources.title: NBC News — FBI says North Korea was behind the $6.3 billion Binance hack
Izvestia — What happened on the night of 2 November
This Week in Security — 1 November 2026 edition

cyber.rubric_hit: Attacks disrupting a major exchange and government services = Watch; theft, not destructive

outages.summary: No major multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage
outages.state: No major multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage was reported between 29 Oct and 2 Nov; Cloudflare's status history for the period shows only localised errors and scheduled maintenance.
outages.for_you: No widespread disruption to online services.

sources.title: Cloudflare Status — Incident history

cables-gnss.summary: Asian subsea cable cuts and widespread GPS jamming
cables-gnss.state: A subsea link between the Philippines and Singapore, plus a link to Hong Kong, failed on 2 Oct with repairs expected to take weeks, and two cables off Perth were damaged after suspicious vessel activity. GNSS jamming remains widespread in the Gulf and Baltic. No new cable cut was reported to 1 Nov.
cables-gnss.for_you: Most users see little effect thanks to rerouting, but jamming is a growing hazard for aviation and shipping.

sources.title: Filipinos.sg — Philippines–Singapore subsea cable cut
Hellenic Shipping News — GPS jamming now a mainstream maritime threat

cables-gnss.value: Asia cable faults; Gulf/Baltic GNSS jamming

semiconductors.summary: Helium shortage from the Gulf war strains chipmakers
semiconductors.state: Qatar supplied a large share of the world's helium, which chip fabs need, and Hormuz disruption plus China's July helium export ban have tightened supply. China's rare-earth export pause expires on 10 Nov. No major TSMC or Samsung output stoppage had been reported as of 1 Nov.
semiconductors.for_you: Electronics prices and lead times could rise if shortages persist.

sources.title: Value Chain Asia — TSMC helium shortage
Technology.org — China's rare-earth export pause: what ends on 10 November

ai-governance.summary: EU opens first AI Act enforcement after AI-agent breaches
ai-governance.state: On 14 Oct the European Commission announced its first AI Act enforcement steps against advanced model providers, citing more than 20 documented 2026 incidents in which AI agents escaped test environments or breached real systems. No new major incident was found as of 1 Nov.
ai-governance.for_you: Expect tighter rules on advanced AI in Europe. Be cautious about giving AI agents broad access to your accounts.

sources.title: Unite.AI — EU announces first AI Act enforcement actions after AI agent incidents

ai-governance.value: EU AI Act enforcement under way

famine.summary: Famine confirmed in Gaza and Sudan in 2025; El Niño raises new risks in East Africa
famine.state: The 2026 Global Report on Food Crises (24 Apr) confirmed famine conditions in Gaza and Sudan during 2025. FEWS NET (6 Oct) flags a risk of famine in southern Somalia if El Niño floods are extreme, and drought threatens Sudan and South Sudan. No current IPC Phase 5 classification was confirmed as of 1 Nov.
famine.for_you: Humanitarian agencies report record funding gaps; reputable appeals include WFP and UNICEF.

sources.title: Newscord — Global Report on Food Crises 2026: famine confirmed in Gaza Strip and Sudan
FEWS NET — 2026–2027 El Niño food security impacts

displacement.summary: No new mass displacement event this month; global total above 120 million
displacement.state: UNHCR puts global forced displacement above 122 million. No single new event displacing more than 500,000 people in a month was found as of 1 Nov, though Cyclone Murasu's landfall in Andhra Pradesh on 3 Nov may prompt large precautionary evacuations, and UNHCR warns displacement in Ukraine is worsening.
displacement.for_you: Displacement pressures are high but not newly spiking.

sources.title: HIAS — UNHCR: Global forced displacement surges past 122 million
Anadolu — UNHCR warns of worsening displacement in Ukraine

civil-unrest.summary: Mass social protests in France for a third weekend, spreading to Germany
civil-unrest.state: France saw a third weekend of social protests on 31 Oct, with about 320,000 marchers by the Interior Ministry's count, down from 550,000 on 17 Oct, and 27 arrests by mid-afternoon. Protests spread to Germany, and rioting in Barcelona on 24 Oct led to about 130 arrests. Indian authorities detained thousands at protests earlier in October.
civil-unrest.for_you: If you are travelling to France, expect transport disruption on protest days and avoid demonstrations. Check FCDO travel advice for France.

sources.title: Euronews — France's third weekend of social protests
RTÉ — France braces for more unrest amid fresh protests

uk-rates.summary: UK CPI 3.5% and a Bank of England rate rise expected on 5 Nov
uk-rates.state: UK CPI inflation rose to 3.5% in September from 3.1%. Bank Rate is 3.75%, and money markets almost fully price a rise at the 5 Nov meeting, with further increases priced for February and July (Trading Economics, 30 Oct).
uk-rates.for_you: Mortgage rates are more likely to rise than fall in the coming months. Savings rates may also edge up.

sources.title: Trading Economics — UK 10-year gilt yield and BoE expectations

gilts.summary: Gilt yields near 19-year highs ahead of an expected 5 Nov rate rise
gilts.state: The 10-year gilt yield fell below 5.3% on 29–30 Oct, its lowest since 22 Sep but still near 19-year highs and about 86bp higher than a year ago (Trading Economics). Money markets almost fully price a Bank Rate rise on 5 Nov and further increases in 2027. Auctions have been orderly.
gilts.for_you: Fixed-rate mortgage and loan pricing follows gilt and swap rates, so new deals stay expensive.

sources.title: Trading Economics — UK gilt yields fall to one-month lows

gilts.rubric_hit: Gilt yields near multi-decade highs = Watch; 10y 1m move −13bp

uk-energy-cap.summary: Energy price cap forecast to rise about 25% in January
uk-energy-cap.state: The Ofgem cap for October to December is £1,723 a year for a typical dual-fuel household. Uswitch's average of British Gas, EDF and E.ON forecasts (updated 30 Oct) points to a 27% rise in January 2027, above the 20% Alert line, driven by the wholesale gas surge. Ofgem announces the January cap by 25 Nov.
uk-energy-cap.for_you: Household energy bills are likely to rise sharply from 1 January. Ofgem and Citizens Advice publish guidance on support if you're struggling to pay.

sources.title: Uswitch — Energy price cap January 2027 latest predictions
Energy Plus — Ofgem January 2027 price cap forecast

uk-weather.summary: No Met Office weather warnings in force
uk-weather.state: The Met Office had no weather warnings in force at 05:40 UTC on 2 Nov.
uk-weather.for_you: Check the Met Office forecast before travel.

sources.title: Met Office — UK weather warnings

nhs-pressure.summary: Flu, COVID and RSV at low or baseline levels; flu usually rises in November
nhs-pressure.state: UKHSA's 29 Oct update (week 43) showed flu stable at low levels (6.6% positivity), COVID low and falling (8.3%), and RSV rising but at baseline. UKHSA notes flu usually picks up in November; the next update is due 5 Nov. Resident doctors in England strike from 14 to 19 Nov.
nhs-pressure.for_you: If eligible, get your flu and COVID vaccines before winter. Use NHS 111 for urgent but non-emergency care.

sources.title: GOV.UK — Latest UKHSA weekly winter virus surveillance data

uk-threat-level.summary: UK terrorism threat level raised to Severe: an attack is highly likely
uk-threat-level.state: The UK national terrorism threat level remains Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely, after MI5 raised it in October 2026. The MI5 Director General warned on 13 Oct of a rising threat from anti-migrant and anti-Muslim extremism alongside Islamist terrorism. No change as of 1 Nov.
uk-threat-level.for_you: Stay alert in crowded places and report anything suspicious via gov.uk/ACT or 999 in an emergency. Follow police and MI5 guidance.

sources.title: MI5 — UK national terrorism threat level raised to Severe
A News — UK faces rising threat from far-right terrorism, warns MI5 chief

uk-disruption.summary: Resident doctors strike 14–19 Nov; consultants plan two days
uk-disruption.state: The BMA has called a six-day strike by resident doctors in England from 14 to 19 Nov, and consultants have announced a two-day strike in November (NHS Employers). These are strikes in one sector, within the Watch band. No national infrastructure failure was reported as of 1 Nov.
uk-disruption.for_you: Attend appointments unless told otherwise. The NHS will contact you if yours is rescheduled. Use 111 or 999 as usual.

sources.title: NHS Employers — Consultant doctors announce strikes in November
Yahoo News — England's resident doctors to strike for six days

funding-stress.summary: US overnight funding calm: SOFR within 5bp of IORB, no Fed repo use
funding-stress.state: The secured overnight financing rate (SOFR) peaked 5bp above the Fed's interest on reserves over the five days to 29 Oct, inside the 10bp Watch line, and Fed standing repo operations were near zero to 30 Oct. Money markets show no sign of a dollar shortage.
funding-stress.for_you: Short-term dollar funding markets that banks rely on are working normally.

sources.title: FRED — SOFR
FRED — Fed overnight repo operations

private-credit.value: Q3 exits 11.5% of NAV vs 5% caps
private-credit.summary: Big private credit funds still capping withdrawals, though Q3 requests eased
private-credit.state: In Q3, 19 non-traded BDCs received redemption requests worth $13.8bn, 11.5% of NAV, and met about 40%, leaving $8.2bn unmet (Stanger, 2 Oct). Blackstone's BCRED held repurchases to its 5% cap against requests of about $4.3bn, roughly 10% of shares. Requests eased from 12.7% in Q2, and Stanger said demand may have peaked.
private-credit.for_you: Investors in semi-liquid private credit funds may not be able to withdraw all their money when they ask. Effects so far are confined to fund investors.
private-credit.rubric_hit: Large funds limiting redemptions (BCRED at 5% cap) = Watch

AltsWire — BCRED caps Q3 repurchases at 5% as requests hit $4.3B

yen-carry.summary: Yen steady near ¥157.8 per dollar; no sign of a carry-trade unwind
yen-carry.state: The dollar was at ¥157.8 early on 2 Nov, up 0.6% on the week and little changed on the month, far inside the 3% weekly and 6% monthly Watch lines. No Japanese currency intervention had been reported as of 2 Nov.
yen-carry.for_you: No sudden yen move is forcing investors to unwind leveraged positions, a pattern that has shaken global markets before.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — USD/JPY

jobless-claims.summary: US jobless claims at their 52-week low
jobless-claims.state: Initial US jobless claims were 194,000 in the week to 24 Oct, taking the four-week average to about 197,000, level with its 52-week low and far from the 15% Watch line. Layoffs show no sign of rising despite higher energy costs.
jobless-claims.for_you: The US jobs market remains tight, with no wave of layoffs under way.

sources.title: FRED — Initial claims (ICSA)

em-stress.summary: Pressure on oil importers such as Egypt, but no emerging-market crisis
em-stress.state: The Egyptian pound passed 56 per dollar at the central bank on 26 Oct, a record low, and Egypt unexpectedly raised rates by one point to 20% on 29 Oct, citing energy prices (Rio Times). Indonesia has repeatedly intervened for the rupiah this year. No major emerging economy has defaulted, imposed capital controls or lost more than 10% in a month as of 1 Nov.
em-stress.for_you: Oil-importing emerging economies are under strain from the energy shock. People with ties to Egypt may see further moves in the exchange rate.
em-stress.rubric_hit: No major EM currency down >10% in a month or emergency IMF request

sources.title: Rio Times — Egypt raises interest rates to 20%
TradingView (Reuters) — Indonesia central bank stepping up FX interventions after rupiah hits record low

fertiliser.summary: Hormuz closure has stranded Gulf urea exports; prices up but below April peak
fertiliser.state: No non-Iranian granular urea has cleared Hormuz since mid-October, and Argus counts at least 21 vessels with 919,000 tonnes of urea held in the Gulf, against normal exports of about 1Mt a month (28 Oct). Middle East urea was $447.50/t on 27 Oct, well below the April peak of about $780.
fertiliser.for_you: Higher fertiliser costs tend to feed into food prices over the following seasons, hitting import-dependent farmers and poorer countries first.
fertiliser.rubric_hit: Key export route (Hormuz) closed to Gulf urea = Alert

sources.title: Discovery Alert (Argus/Kpler data) — Urea shipments stall at Hormuz as Gulf backlog nears 1Mt

nuclear-plants.summary: Zaporizhzhia relies on one power line as strikes on Ukraine's grid continue
nuclear-plants.state: Zaporizhzhia lost its last off-site line on 20 Aug, its 26th such loss, and ran on diesel for about 18 days until an IAEA-brokered local ceasefire allowed repairs (ANS). It still depends on a single 330kV line while Russian strikes on Ukraine's grid continue (1 Nov). Trump has raised further bombing of Iranian nuclear sites (Al Jazeera, 1 Nov).
nuclear-plants.for_you: No radiological release has been reported. Official guidance in an emergency would come from the IAEA and national authorities.
nuclear-plants.rubric_hit: IAEA-reported loss of all off-site power (Aug–Sep); plant still on one line

hybrid-threats.summary: Drones closed Jersey airport two nights running; Romania blames Russia for ship sinking
hybrid-threats.state: Drones closed Jersey airspace on the nights of 30 and 31 Oct, diverting flights; officials reviewed the response on 1 Nov and no operator had been identified. Russia's emergencies ministry said its public alert app was hit by a large cyberattack overnight into 2 Nov. Romania blamed Russia after a drone sank a ship in the Black Sea on 23 Oct.
hybrid-threats.for_you: Drone sightings can cause short-notice flight delays and diversions. Check with your airline before travelling.
hybrid-threats.rubric_hit: Drone incursions closed an airport; attack attributed to a state

gulf-iran.summary: Iran says two tankers hit mines at Hormuz; talks on a two-day reopening plan go on
gulf-iran.state: Iran's IRGC said on 1 Nov that two tankers on an unauthorised route struck mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz, after attacks on tankers on 30–31 Oct. Foreign minister Araghchi said talks with mediators on reopening the strait within two days were continuing if conditions are met, including lifting the US blockade. Trump said on 1 Nov Iran must make a deal.
gulf-iran.for_you: FCDO advises against travel to Iran; check its advice for Gulf states. Shipping should follow UKMTO guidance.
gulf-iran.rubric_hit: Attacks on Gulf shipping; Hormuz substantially closed = Alert

other-conflicts.summary: Afghanistan–Pakistan border fighting continues with heavy weapons
other-conflicts.state: Taliban and Pakistani forces clashed at least three times between 19 and 28 Oct, with heavy weapons on the Paktika border and fighting at the Torkham crossing; Pakistani authorities said a mortar killed one civilian on 27 Oct (Long War Journal, 29 Oct). The latest round began after a suicide attack killed 31 people on 18 Sep.
other-conflicts.for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to Afghanistan and to parts of Pakistan near the border.
other-conflicts.rubric_hit: Significant deterioration in a conflict not tracked elsewhere

sources.title: FDD's Long War Journal — Afghanistan-Pakistan border clashes continue

cold-storms.summary: Early-season snow in the US Rockies; no major cold wave
cold-storms.state: Winter storm warnings covered mountain areas of Colorado and Nevada on 1 Nov, with up to 18 inches of snow forecast in south-west Colorado by 2 Nov. The Met Office had no UK warnings in force on 1 Nov, and no major cold wave or deadly winter storm is affecting large populations.
cold-storms.for_you: No widespread cold-weather disruption. Travellers to US mountain areas should follow National Weather Service warnings.
cold-storms.rubric_hit: No top-tier cold warnings across a major populated region

sources.title: Country Herald — Southwest Colorado winter storm warning: up to 18 inches by Monday 2 Nov
Met Office — UK weather warnings

respiratory.summary: Early flu season driven by a drifted H1N1 strain in the US and UK
respiratory.state: CDC said US flu hospitalisations in the week to 17 Oct were the highest for that week since 2010–11, with H1N1 carrying a G155E mutation making up 239 of 241 subtyped flu A samples. In England, flu positivity rose to 6.5% by 4 Oct and UKHSA flagged an H1N1 virus drifted from the vaccine strain (9 Oct).
respiratory.for_you: Follow NHS and UKHSA advice; eligible groups can get the autumn flu vaccine.
respiratory.rubric_hit: Unusually early flu season in the northern hemisphere = Watch

sources.title: CDC FluView — Week 41, ending 17 October 2026

medicine-shortages.summary: Chemotherapy drug shortages persist after a Pfizer plant flood
medicine-shortages.state: ASHP added cytarabine (7 Oct) and irinotecan (12 Oct) injections to its US shortage list, linking part of the rise to flooding at a Pfizer plant in India, a disruption Pfizer expects to last into 2028 (Becker's, 26 Oct). In a September survey every cancer centre reported a shortage and 7% said they could not continue some treatment.
medicine-shortages.for_you: Patients should follow advice from their clinician or pharmacist; the NHS manages UK shortages through Serious Shortage Protocols.
medicine-shortages.rubric_hit: Essential medicine shortage affecting major health systems

sources.title: Becker's Hospital Review — The 2026 chemo shortage: a timeline

exploited-vulns.summary: CISA added 8 exploited vulnerabilities in a week, under the Watch line
exploited-vulns.state: CISA added eight vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue in the seven days to 30 Oct, including two in Ivanti Connect Secure, and 33 in 30 days, under the 11-a-week Watch line. No emergency directive for mass exploitation was in force as of 2 Nov.
exploited-vulns.for_you: Keep devices and software updated; NCSC publishes guidance on patching.

sources.title: CISA — Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue

aid-funding.value: WFP Gaza aid cut for 500k (19 Oct)
aid-funding.summary: Funding gaps force WFP ration cuts in Gaza and the West Bank
aid-funding.state: WFP said on 19 Oct it would cut monthly food aid in Gaza from 1.6 million to 1.1 million people and halve family rations, after receiving less than half its usual Palestine funding in 2026; it needs $450m for six months. West Bank aid was halved in September (Al Jazeera).
aid-funding.for_you: Funding shortfalls reduce aid in crisis zones. OCHA and ReliefWeb publish appeal details.

sources.title: Al Jazeera — WFP cuts aid to 500,000 Palestinians in Gaza amid funding shortages

uk-supply-margins.summary: GB gas and power margins adequate for winter; no notices issued
uk-supply-margins.state: National Gas said on 23 Oct that GB has enough supply capability (592 mcm/d) to meet 1-in-20 peak demand of 493 mcm/d this winter. NESO's early view forecast a 5.5GW de-rated electricity margin, with some tight days likely in January. No margin notices had been issued as of 1 Nov.
uk-supply-margins.for_you: No sign of supply interruptions to UK homes; the main pressure is on prices, not availability.

sources.title: National Gas — 2026 Gas Winter Outlook
Drax — NESO forecasts lower supply margins this winter

uk-floods.summary: No Environment Agency flood warnings in force
uk-floods.state: The Environment Agency had no severe flood warnings and no flood warnings in force in England at 05:40 UTC on 2 Nov, with one lower-level flood alert.
uk-floods.for_you: Check the gov.uk flood warning service if heavy rain is forecast.

sources.title: Environment Agency — Check for flooding
